description: ol-reserved-word (issue #427, M4 audit): `define axes ... end` redefines `axes`, a Geometry overlay primitive (spec/geometry-module.md's `## axes`). The static checker flags the procedure name at its own span. `spec/grammar.md:412` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- so a conforming implementation raises here with or without `geometry` claimed. The Core-only direction is pinned separately by geometry/check/reserved-word-not-gated-without-geometry, which raises the same way with `geometry` absent. The overlays are the deliberate counterpoint to `geometry/check/stdlib-names-are-definable`: `grid`/`axes`/`measure` are renderer-backed PRIMITIVES and so are built-in names, while `polygon`/`circle`/`arc`/`star`/`area`/`perimeter` are OpenLogo source and stay free to define (spec/grammar.md:416).
